title: Pinocchio, the wooden puppet.
lines: In a little village in Italy lives an old woodcarver.
He makes toys out of wood.
Geppetto lives alone, with his cat Figaro and his goldfish Cleo.
One evening he makes a wooden puppet.
A little boy with a pointy nose.
I wish Pinocchio were a real boy.
That night a blue fairy comes.
But you're not a real boy yet, says the fairy.
For that you must be brave, honest and kind.
The fairy gives Pinocchio a friend.
He helps Pinocchio choose between right and wrong.
The next morning he sends Pinocchio to school.
But on the way Pinocchio meets a sly fox.
At the theatre he gets locked in a cage.
The boss wants him to dance every day.
The more he lies, the longer his nose gets.
A little bird's nest even grows on it.
He went out to sea in a little boat to look for Pinocchio.
A big whale swallowed the little boat.
In the whale's tummy he finds Geppetto.
Pinocchio pushes Geppetto to the beach.
That night the blue fairy comes back.
You were brave, honest and kind, she says.
